environment.note: Additive, migration-free correctness fix to broker_intelligence/correlation.py (ADR-0126), closing filed backlog item (c) in docs/NEXT.md. DEFECT: one owner can legitimately hold two withdrawals sharing a broker_reference_id across DIFFERENT accounts (uniq_withdrawal_account_reference is per-account). _find_by_reference's account-LESS bridge did Withdrawal.objects.filter(owner_id, broker_reference_id=ref).first() and advanced an ARBITRARY match -- so an account-less COMPLETION (genuine payout email, category UNKNOWN) on such a collision advanced the WRONG withdrawal to COMPLETED. FIX (two scoped parts): (1) the account-less bridge fetches [:2] and returns the row only when exactly one matches, else None (fail closed) -- the advance-only passes (correlate_completion_event, correlate_neutral_advance_event) then return OUT_UNRESOLVED (never fabricate, never advance, event stays re-evaluable); (2) the create-capable pass 1 (_correlate_by_reference) guards the ambiguous account-less collision -> _mark_event(AMBIGUOUS) + OUT_AMBIGUOUS, so it never fabricates a phantom account-NULL row (metric inflation), mirroring _correlate_by_heuristic's len(cands)>=2 => AMBIGUOUS. Account-RESOLVED bridge, cross-owner isolation, idempotency, and zero/single-match create all unchanged. Monitoring/correlation engine remains DARK (no live caller enabled). No migration, no flag, no schema/DB change, no broker/MT5/host contact. Base is current main 1c05b7b0 (includes the merged GFX-168 #692 + the disjoint TIM #693).
